name: JTL-Wawi
description: JTL-Wawi — the e-commerce ERP behind a large share of German online retail. Read customers, items, stock, sales orders and shipments from your on-premises JTL-Wawi via the JTL API Server. REST v1, Wawi API key.
instructions:
**JTL-Wawi is on-premises Windows software and does not speak HTTP on its own.** The REST API is served by the separate **JTL API Server** (sometimes called the Wawi API / `JTL-Wawi API`), which you install alongside the Wawi database.
1. Install the JTL API Server on the machine that reaches your JTL-Wawi MSSQL database, and start its service.
2. Register an app: in JTL-Wawi open **Admin → App registration** and start the registration, then send `POST /api/eazybusiness/authentication` with the app's details (`AppId`, `DisplayName`, `Description`, `Version`, `ProviderName`, `ProviderWebsite`, `MandatoryApiScopes`) and an `x-challengecode` header. Approve the request in Wawi and call `GET /api/eazybusiness/authentication/{registrationId}` with the same challenge code: the response holds the permanent `ApiKey`. It is shown only once.
3. Set `JTL_WAWI_URL` to the API server's root (e.g. `https://wawi.example.com:5883`, no trailing slash) and `JTL_WAWI_API_KEY` to the key. The adapter sends `Authorization: Wawi <key>`.

**Set `JTL_WAWI_APP_ID` and `JTL_WAWI_APP_VERSION`** to the `AppId` (e.g. `MyApp/1.0.0`) and `Version` used at registration. They travel as the `X-AppId` and `X-AppVersion` headers on every call.

**Pagination is page-based.** List endpoints take `pageNumber` (from 1) and `pageSize`, and the response body carries `TotalItems`, `TotalPages` and `HasNextPage`. Ask for a page, look at the total, ask for the next — do not loop blindly.

**Item vs stock.** `jtl_wawi_list_items` returns the article master (name, SKU, prices); `jtl_wawi_get_item_stock` returns the per-warehouse quantities from `/stocks`. Availability questions need the second one.

**Orders and shipments.** `jtl_wawi_list_sales_orders` filters by order number, customer or date (no free-text search). An order's lines come from `jtl_wawi_list_sales_order_line_items`. Shipments are delivery notes (`/deliveryNotes`); their packages carry the tracking id and URL.

**Checked against JTL's published OpenAPI (ERP API 1.x), not a live system.** Paths, parameters and the `Wawi` auth scheme follow developer.jtl-software.com; JTL's 2.0 API changes many endpoints, and this adapter stays on the `/v1` routes. Treat a 404 as a docs-versus-reality gap and check the developer portal before concluding that the credential is wrong. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch.
- On an internal host (`wawi.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (Lager) configured in JTL-Wawi with their id, name and type. No parameters — the quickest check that the API server and the app key line up.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_items
tools.description: List articles from the item master with their SKU, name, prices, EAN and manufacturer. Use a search fragment to find one article before asking about its stock.

searchKeyWord.description: Search fragment matched against SKU, name and EAN.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_get_item
tools.description: Read one article in full: its SKU, descriptions, dimensions, prices, categories and supplier links.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_get_item_stock
tools.description: Read the stock of one article per warehouse and storage location: total quantity and the quantity locked for shipment. This — not the item master — is what an availability question needs.

warehouseId.description: Restrict to one warehouse, from jtl_wawi_list_warehouses.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their customer number, company, contact name, address and customer group.

searchKeyWord.description: Search fragment matched against name, company and customer number.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer in full: billing and delivery addresses, payment and shipping defaults, and the customer group they belong to.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with their order number, customer, date, addresses, payment and shipping details. Filter by order number, customer or creation date; there is no free-text search on this endpoint.

externalOrderNumber.description: Order number from the sales channel, e.g. the shop or marketplace order id.

createdSince.description: Only orders created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

createdUntil.description: Only orders created before this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_get_sales_order
tools.description: Read the header of one sales order: addresses, customer, order date, payment and shipping details, cancellation state. Line items are not part of it; use jtl_wawi_list_sales_order_line_items.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_sales_order_line_items
tools.description: Read the line items of one sales order: SKU, name, quantity ordered, delivered and returned, net and gross price, discount and tax rate.

salesOrderId.description: Numeric JTL sales order id, from jtl_wawi_list_sales_orders.

tools.name: jtl_wawi_list_shipments
tools.description: List delivery notes (Lieferscheine) with their number, date and packages; each package carries its tracking id, tracking URL and shipped date. Filter by order number or customer — the answer to 'has it gone out yet'.

salesOrderNumber.description: Wawi order number the delivery notes belong to.
